text: Rank OpenAlex author IDs by distinct snapshot works on which their own authorship is_columbia, descending, with author ID ascending for ties. Connect selected IDs on any shared snapshot work (both need not list Columbia on that work), with one undirected edge weighted by distinct shared works, keeping isolates.

Use a deterministic D3 force layout for the two nontrivial connected components (link attraction with stronger ties assigned shorter target lengths, charge repulsion and collision avoidance), packed into separate panels. Arrange full-network isolates in a labeled grid. The minimum shared-works filter hides edges without moving nodes or recomputing components.
